entities.name: 2020 COVID-19 pandemic in Wyoming
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The COVID-19 pandemic was confirmed to have reached the U.S. state of Wyoming in March 2020. On April 13, 2020, Wyoming became the last state in the U.S. to report its first death from COVID-19.
